description: Figure: conservation of the experimentally defined Mnt2 GDP-mannose/Mn2+ site across S. cerevisiae GT71 paralogs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
df=pd.read_csv("gt71_site_conservation.csv")
order=["MNT4","MNN1","MNT3","MNN2","MNN5"]
labels=[f"{r.Mnt2_aa}{r.Mnt2_pos}" for r in df.itertuples()]
roles=df['role'].tolist()
M=np.zeros((len(order),len(df)))
ann=[]
for i,t in enumerate(order):
    row=[]
    for j,r in enumerate(df.itertuples()):
        aa=getattr(r,t+"_aa")
        ref=r.Mnt2_aa
        if aa==ref: M[i,j]=2
        elif aa=='-': M[i,j]=0
        else:
            from itertools import product
            B={('A','V'):1,('V','A'):1,('Y','F'):1,('F','Y'):1,('M','L'):1,('L','M'):1,('E','D'):1,('D','E'):1,
               ('S','T'):1,('T','S'):1,('S','A'):1,('A','S'):1,('K','R'):1,('R','K'):1,('H','Y'):1,('Y','H'):1,
               ('N','S'):1,('S','N'):1,('G','S'):1,('S','G'):1,('I','L'):1,('L','I'):1,('H','E'):1,('E','H'):1}
            M[i,j]=1 if B.get((ref,aa),0) else 0.4
        row.append(aa)
    ann.append(row)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
cmap=plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#c44","#e8a33d","#8fbf6a","#2f7d3a"])
bounds=[0,0.7,1.5,1.9,2.5]
norm=plt.matplotlib.colors.BoundaryNorm(bounds,cmap.N)
ax.imshow(M,cmap=cmap,norm=norm,aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(order)):
    for j in range(len(df)):
        ax.text(j,i,ann[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,color="white",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{l}\n{'M' if 'metal' in r else ''}" for l,r in zip(labels,roles)],fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order,fontsize=10)
ax.set_title("Mnt2 (PDB 7XJV) GDP-mannose / Mn$^{2+}$ site residues mapped onto S. cerevisiae GT71 paralogs\n"
             "green = identical to Mnt2, light green = conservative, orange = non-conservative, M = Mn$^{2+}$ ligand",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("Mnt2 residue (UniProt P53059 numbering); boxed letters are the aligned residue in each paralog",fontsize=9)
for j,r in enumerate(roles):
    if 'metal' in r: ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j-0.5,-0.5),1,len(order),fill=False,ec='black',lw=2))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("MNT4 non-identical positions vs Mnt2 site:")
for r in df.itertuples():
    if r.MNT4_aa!=r.Mnt2_aa: print(f"  Mnt2 {r.Mnt2_aa}{r.Mnt2_pos} ({r.role}) -> MNT4 {r.MNT4}")
